sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 120. Magic damage (Dark).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Increases dark elemental defense by 60 for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Increases Unison gauge gains by 2 for 60 seconds.
-Applies Dark Element to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all enemies. Removes resurrection.
[Additional Unison Effect] Applies Blind to all enemies for 60 seconds with a success value of 80.
[Additional Unison Effect] During Element Battles when this Unison effect is used, the values of the Light and Time element weakening effects on monsters are increased by 20%.
Only [Amethyst Smoke] Sagiri can be used as Unlocking Potential material
